scope.observation_order: each decision input_snapshot is read before that row's issue-time enemy-manager frame observation and physical dispatch
scope.input_snapshot_atomicity: raw/current/previous are sequential process-memory reads, not one native atomic snapshot
scope.corroborated_sequential_publication_edge: input_snapshot.previous->current is one consecutive edge of the currently outstanding ordered dispatch, raw equals current, and the later manager-frame-coherent diagnostic capture holds the same current mask
scope.issued_delay_support_contract: AdaptiveControlDelay snapshot-to-visible-input estimator coordinate; pending remaining support subtracts snapshot age
scope.first_final_observation_contract: first later decision capture that sees the final target before replacement; it is an observation upper bound, not the exact priority-17 publication callback
scope.audited_manager_gap: 0..64; larger or negative gaps are censored rather than interpreted as publication latency

estimator_coordinate.reason: the trace has no priority-17 callback serial, issue-adjacent native publication marker, or atomic input triple; enemy-manager frames and asynchronous decision captures cannot recover skipped callback count

required_bounded_probe.minimum_native_event: monotone priority-17 publication serial plus raw, old current, new current, and contemporaneous manager frame
required_bounded_probe.minimum_issue_event: pre-dispatch and post-dispatch publication serial bounds plus ordered edge/transaction identity
required_bounded_probe.runtime_contract: default-off trace-only bounded ring; overflow or read failure marks the interval unknown and must not stop a stage
